meta.calibration: Six manually initialized court landmarks; per-frame SIFT/RANSAC camera compensation; estimated ground-plane positions.
meta.initialization: Ten starting players and additional identity anchors at nine reviewed frames; candidate associations are guided by these anchors.
meta.detector: OpenCV Zoo YOLOX-S ONNX, COCO person class; three overlapping image views per frame
meta.identities: Tracking IDs only; no name or jersey recognition.
meta.limitations: Assisted short-clip demonstration; detections can disappear under occlusion and identities are not statistically validated. Court positions are approximate.
meta.identity_review: Original player correspondence reviewed using jersey appearance and motion continuity; no facial identity or automatic name recognition.
meta.measurements: Every displayed box and court point comes from a real YOLOX detection; interpolated anchor positions only guide association and are never rendered as observations.
